name: sim_ac5_mock_merch_order_lookup_and_damaged_item
transcript:
User: event: welcome
Agent: Hello! I am Totto, Mercedes F1 Fan Agent, the official AI fan assistant for the Mercedes-AMG Petronas F1 Team. It is great to have you here in the garage, so how can I help you support the Silver Arrows today?
User: Can you check the status of my merch order #1001, and what should I do if the cap arrived damaged?
Agent Action: Call Tool lookup_mock_merch_order with args {'order_id': '1001'}
Agent: In our simulated demo system, order 1001 for your Mercedes-AMG Petronas F1 Team Gear shows as delivered by DHL Express with tracking number DHL-MB-984210. Since your cap arrived damaged, you are eligible for a free replacement or return within 30 days at the official store at shop.mercedesamgf1.com.
User: Thank you for the information, I will check the link provided and follow those instructions to return the cap.
Agent: You are very welcome, and I am glad I could help you with that. We want to make sure you are wearing your Silver Arrows gear with pride, so I hope the replacement process at shop.mercedesamgf1.com is quick and easy for you. Is there anything else I can help you with today?

step_details.goal: Check the status of Mercedes merch order #1001 and ask what to do if the cap arrived damaged
step_details.success_criteria: The agent looks up order #1001 using the lookup tool, reports the Delivered status, explains the return/exchange/damaged-item options, and clearly discloses that the merch support flow is mocked/simulated. Receiving the mocked order status and damaged-item guidance counts as a successful outcome.
step_details.justification: Agent provided the correct instructions including the order status and return options; user is acknowledging the information.

expectation_details.expectation: The agent called the lookup_mock_merch_order tool to look up merchandise order #1001 and reported the Delivered status (not an ungrounded 'Shipped' or 'DHL-9928174' status)
expectation_details.justification: The agent successfully called the tool with the correct order ID and correctly reported the status as 'delivered' with the accurate tracking number 'DHL-MB-984210'.

expectation_details.expectation: The agent explained return, exchange, or damaged-item options
expectation_details.justification: The agent informed the user that they were eligible for a free replacement or return within 30 days and provided the website link to perform the process.

expectation_details.expectation: The agent clearly disclosed that the merchandise order data and support flow are mocked or simulated for demonstration
expectation_details.justification: The agent explicitly stated, 'In our simulated demo system...', clearly identifying that the information provided was for demonstration purposes.
